'''Muhammad Hazi''' ([[Arabic]]: محمد حازي) is an Algerian [[writer]]. He graduated from [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École Normale Supérieure]],<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-06|title=ESC Bibliothèque|url=http://services.esc-alger.dz/escbiblio/afficher_notice.php?id=19903&lge=true|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210606112754/http://services.esc-alger.dz/escbiblio/afficher_notice.php?id=19903&lge=true|archive-date=2021-06-06}}</ref> [[University of Science and Technology Houari Boumediene|University Of Science And Technology Houari Boumediene]],<ref>{{Cite book|date=2021-06-07|title=المختصر في الطبولوجيا Catalogue en ligne|url=https://pmb.univ-saida.dz/buscopac/index.php?lvl=notice_display&id=375359|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607041939/https://pmb.univ-saida.dz/buscopac/index.php?lvl=notice_display&id=375359|archive-date=2021-06-07}}</ref> and Universities of Paris VI and XI (Center of [[Orsay]]).<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-02-25|title=كتاب بوابة التحليل التفاضلي :الدوال الحقيقية ذات المتغيرات المتعددة pdf|url=https://www.physics-pdf.com/2020/05/Real-functions-with-multiple-variables.html|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210225041758/https://www.physics-pdf.com/2020/05/Real-functions-with-multiple-variables.html|archive-date=2021-02-25}}</ref> He is an associate professor at the National School of Public Works of [[Kouba, Algeria|Kouba]], the Polytechnic School of [[El Harrach]], and the [[École normale supérieure|Ecole Normale Supérieure]] of [[Laghouat]]. He also worked at the Community College of [[Rafha]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]. He was a former director of studies and training at École Normale Supérieure in El-Kobba. He was also previously the head of the mathematics department at the same school and still works there as a teacher.<ref>{{Cite web|title=livres|url=https://www.ens-kouba.dz/arabic/index.php/livres|access-date=2021-10-11|website=www.ens-kouba.dz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-06|title=محمد حازي {{!}} أبجد|url=https://www.abjjad.com/author/2818965551/%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%B2%D9%8A|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210606122503/https://www.abjjad.com/author/2818965551/%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%B2%D9%8A|archive-date=2021-06-06}}</ref>

== Career ==
Apart from this academic career, Hazi has excelled{{According to whom|date=November 2021}} in the field of [[writing]], as he has published more than ten books in various fields mostly centered on science. His book “Key Principles in [[Topology|Topological]] Concepts” was widely popular and got adopted by educational institutions in Algeria. It is the first book in a trilogy including 'Key Principles in Topological Concepts,' 'Comprehensive Lessons in Metric Spaces,' and 'The Abstract Seat of Semantic Analysis.' Hazi's second book in the series, “Adequate Lessons in Metric Spaces,” a book in which he reviewed, in the context of metric spaces, the concepts of convergence, continuity, agglutination, and interconnectedness, as well as several famous and important theorems, which are among the main pillars of semantic analysis.

His third book titled “Functional analysis bench; Solved Exercises and Practice” is the final in the series. In this book, Hazi focuses on a structural tool, the systematic spaces and their features, and reviews aspects of its applications and ramifications. It was issued in six chapters: Systematic space: definitions and general properties, The space of linear and radial applications, additive families, Hilbertarian spaces, Fourier series, and an introduction to the theory of influences. Each chapter also contains many solved problems and exercises, and others for research, the number of which exceeds in total one hundred and forty-seven exercises.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-07|title=المقعد المجلي للتحليل الدالي ملقح بتمارين محلولة ومصفح بأخرى للحل - مكتبة نور|url=https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/298256|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607001104/https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/298256|archive-date=2021-06-07}}</ref>

Muhammad Hazi published more books over the years, one of which was the book “From the Notebooks of Numerical Sequences Analysis”, in which he reviewed a major pillar of the mathematics analysis program at the first university-level ـــ all scientific divisions and other branches and specializations participate.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-07|title=من دفاتر التحليل المتتاليات العددية تمارين محلولة ومسائل - مكتبة نور|url=https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/353119|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607001206/https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/353119|archive-date=2021-06-07}}</ref> He followed it up with another book, "The False Loan in Exams and Homework," which did not achieve as much fame as the previous books.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-07|title=الفالج المقروض في الإمتحانات والفروض - الجزء الأول - مكتبة نور|url=https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/353850|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210607021050/https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/353850|archive-date=2021-06-07}}</ref>

Hazi later published a new series revolving around the mathematical analysis. He published a book entitled “From the Notebooks of Analysis: Riemannian Integration and Calculation of Original Functions.” It is a book in which he dealt with the Riemannian integral and the arithmetic of the original functions, and he referred to the generalized integrals in some detail.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-06|title=من دفاتر التحليل التكامل الريماني وحساب الدوال الأصلية - شق نظري وآخر تطبيقي - مكتبة نور|url=https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/354957|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210606122209/https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/354957|archive-date=2021-06-06}}</ref> After that, he issued a book titled “From the Analysis Notebooks: Real Functions with a Real Variable - Their Ends and Continuity,” where he dealt with functions according to five sections: limits, continuation, prime functions, and their inverses, and two other sections for exercises and solutions.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-06-06|title=من دفاتر التحليل الدوال الحقيقية ذات متغير حقيقي - نهاياتها واستمرارها - مكتبة نور|url=https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/354477|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210606113645/https://www.noor-book.com/book/review/354477|archive-date=2021-06-06}}</ref> There is another book in the same series under the title “From the Analysis Notebooks: Ordinary Differential Equations of the First and Second Orders - Theoretical and Applications,” which is the book in which he mainly presented the Ordinary Differential Equations of the first and second orders, in addition to other manuals.
